name: CreatePrivateDnsEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the private instance
parameters.name: access_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of private DNS. When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, Port and IpProtocol are required. When PrivateDnsType is set to PrivateZone, the backend automatically sets the port to 53 and uses the default protocol. Valid values:
PrivateZone
Custom (default)
parameters.help_zh:
私有DNS类型。当 PrivateDnsType=Custom 时 Port、IpProtocol 为条件必填；PrivateZone 时后端自动填充为 53/默认协议。取值：
PrivateZone
Custom（默认）
parameters.name: private_dns_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary vSwitch. The zone of PrimaryVSwitchId and StandbyVSwitchId must be a zone that supports private DNS. Otherwise, an error is returned. The region must also be in the supported list
parameters.help_zh: 主交换机 ID。本参数必填，缺失时返回 -200103；PrimaryVSwitchId 和 StandbyVSwitchId 所在地域及可用区必须支持私有 DNS 防火墙
parameters.name: primary_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary vSwitch. The zone of PrimaryVSwitchId and StandbyVSwitchId must be a zone that supports private DNS. Otherwise, error code -200534 is returned. The region must also be in the supported list
parameters.help_zh: 备交换机id。PrimaryVSwitchId / StandbyVSwitchId 所在可用区需为当前支持私有 DNS 的可用区，否则返回 -200534；地域也需在支持列表内
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the primary vSwitch
parameters.name: primary_vswitch_ip

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the secondary vSwitch
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_ip

parameters.help_en:
The IP protocol. Valid values:
TCP
UDP
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud firewall. Valid values:
internet
vpc
nat
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙类型。取值：
internet
vpc
nat
parameters.name: firewall_type

parameters.help_en:
The primary DNS server.
When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, you must specify PrimaryDns and StandbyDns
parameters.help_zh:
主DNS。
PrivateDnsType=Custom时 PrimaryDns/StandbyDns 需自行提供
parameters.name: primary_dns

parameters.help_en:
The secondary DNS server.

When PrivateDnsType is set to Custom, you must specify PrimaryDns and StandbyDns
parameters.help_zh:
备DNS。

PrivateDnsType=Custom 时 PrimaryDns/StandbyDns 需自行提供
parameters.name: standby_dns
